summary: the scans an averaged measurement needs to reach a signal-to-noise ratio, and their time

inputs.name: single_scan_snr
inputs.meaning: the signal-to-noise ratio of one scan, above zero

inputs.name: target_snr
inputs.meaning: the signal-to-noise ratio the measurement is to reach

outputs.name: scan_count
outputs.meaning: the smallest whole number of scans whose average reaches the target

validity: noise independent from scan to scan; at least one scan

source.citation: averaging n independent scans divides the noise by the square root of n while the signal stays
source.locus: the square-root law of signal averaging
